Scenario test cases: describe a user goal and the system simulates the user; Simulation test cases split a journey into ordered goals; personas customise the simulated user.

A test case can run several times in one evaluation run to check consistency and flakiness; each execution is a separate result. No aggregate pass-rate-over-runs metric is described on the page.
AI-assessed metrics: semantic match (0-4), hallucination detection, goal completion with justification, user goal satisfaction; combined into task completion.
